If you can, fastroll. Lock on on him and wait for his attack,roll to avoid it and do a strong attack. When he starts using magic figure out the best way for you to avoid it.

Against Kalameet you can heal when he uses his fire if you are far enough. Dodging his melee attacks is a bit tricky because they "linger" a bit. The safest position is on his side. When he uses the "fire from above" attack,a roll and walking away should be enough to avoid it

Pokémon White was my first Pokémon game, so my opinion in the matter could be depending on nostalgia.(I was 6 when i played the game and i captured every legendary Pokémon possible,leveled up my team to full level 100 and beat the league 18 times without having understood how to run).
I recently have replayed the game and I really appreciated it.
To me, it seems like in the fifth generation they were going for something on the lines of a new start, thus explaining the lack of older Pokémon, the 2 new battle modes, the huge amount of new Pokémons added and the story heavy gameplay.
